🚨 *new alert — needs human* (15th cluster of B011R3D650X frontend-errors flap)
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  •  confidence: 0.60  •  bug-type guess: unknown  •  alerts in group: 2

Symptoms:
  - Two empty-text alerts from Datadog monitor bot `B011R3D650X` in `alert-frontend-errors`, 4m01s apart (10:32:12Z and 10:36:13Z).
  - 15th cluster of the same monitor+channel+empty-text shape since 2026-05-13T19:14Z. Prior cluster (`cc184c0d33f2d8b6`) tail was 2026-05-14T21:04:12Z — the flap quieted overnight for ~13h28m, then resumed.
  - Cron has been silent since 2026-05-14T22:13Z (~13h gap). Heartbeat at 2026-05-15T10:46:56Z flagged 5 alerts unlogged in the prior 6h; only these 2 fall inside the current 65-min poll window, so the other 3 (alert-system×2, alert-runtime-monitoring×1) remain permanently unlogged for this cycle.

Trace IDs: none — alert text is empty (Slack-blocks-only payload), and the monitor IDs aren't surfaced in `conversations.history` without DD API access.
Likely cause: same as last 14 clusters — a Datadog frontend-errors monitor on `B011R3D650X` is in a sustained alert/no-data flap. Root cause is undiagnosable from Slack alone; the 13h overnight lull is informative but uninterpretable without DD/ES.

Suggested next action: 1 of these 3 is still the only path forward:
  1. Open DD and identify monitor `B011R3D650X` posts into `#alert-frontend-errors`; mute or retune it.
  2. Provision `DD_API_KEY`/`DD_APP_KEY` (and ELK creds, SSH bastion) into the routine env so the bot can actually investigate.
  3. Flip `kb/config.json.enabled` to `false` until either of the above is done, to stop accumulating zero-information `needs-human` clusters.

Also worth flagging: the routine cron itself has been silent for ~13h (last successful poll-cycle 2026-05-14T22:13Z, this is a manual local run). The heartbeat is firing degraded warnings but the cron is not picking up. Worth checking why scheduled triage routine isn't firing.

  • https://method.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1778841373123569  (alert-frontend-errors, 10:36 UTC)

  • DD logs: unavailable (DD_API_KEY missing)
  • Kibana: unavailable (ELK_BASE_URL missing)
  • SQL / Mongo: unavailable (SSH bastion creds missing)
  • Prior investigation: docs/investigations/2026-05-14-cc184c0d33f2d8b6.md (14th cluster, 6h33m end-to-end flap on 2026-05-14)
